{{Top}}
'''Lommite''' was a type of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was one of the primary constituent materials of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]], [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] canopies, and [[dura-armor]]. It was the principal export of [[Dorvalla Mining]]. The ore was chalky in both texture and coloring, though lommite crystals were also known to exist. It could also be used by artists and molded like clay.

The planets [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]], [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], and [[Ord Thoden]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> had extensive lommite deposits, as did the moon of [[Koratas]].<ref name="Cracken's Threat Dossier">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
